results.question: Will a late EMI affect my credit score?
results.answer: Yes. Repayments are reported to the credit bureaus every month, and an EMI paid late is reported as overdue for the days it was late, even if paid in the same month [KB-L-08]. A failed debit that is paid within the retry window before the reporting date is not reported as overdue [KB-L-08]. If you believe bureau data is wrong, corrections are made within 21 days of a valid dispute [KB-L-08]. Would you like me to check your recent payment history for any late or failed EMIs?

By default the EMI is recalculated on the outstanding principal for the remaining tenure unless you ask to change the tenure instead [LT-4.2].
